approved_principles: Trailaris Market Execution Engine remains in Trailaris-controlled infrastructure and is not distributed to customer-controlled machines.
Customer environments receive only the Trailaris Desktop terminal, MT5 Executor/Dashboard, hardened execution adapter, Position Guardian and telemetry/health components.
Customer-facing trade rationale is high-level and useful but must not disclose exact strategy formulas, weights, thresholds or ranking logic.
One paid live-account entitlement applies to one exact live trading account; additional live accounts require additional paid entitlements/fees.
No pre-trade signal broadcasting, live-signal API/webhook/export or reusable cross-account execution instruction is permitted.
MT5 receives only cryptographically authenticated, account-bound execution/management envelopes; no full Market Execution Engine logic is installed in MT5.
If central connectivity is lost, no new positions may be opened; existing positions may only be managed within a previously authorized contingency safety envelope.
Central telemetry, alerting, administrative suspension/revocation and result verification remain authoritative control-plane functions.
change_control: Any departure from these security, licensing, distribution or anti-signal-resale principles requires explicit user authorization and a separately versioned architecture change.
